summary.text: Richard Blumenthal was elected to the U.S. Senate from Connecticut in 2010 and reelected in 2016 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: He served in the Marine Corps Reserve from 1970 to 1976, as U.S. Attorney for Connecticut from 1977 to 1981, in the Connecticut House from 1984 to 1987 and State Senate from 1987 to 1990, and as Connecticut Attorney General from 1991 to 2011.
He attended Harvard College and Yale Law School.
